raw_graphql_pull_request.body:
## Motivation

On Hopper, pooled DSA with an FP8 KV cache can resolve to `flashmla_kv`, which cannot handle pooled tail tokens. The server loads weights before failing during CUDA graph capture.

Report unsupported configurations during argument resolution and keep that check consistent with runtime backend support.

## Modifications

Startup and runtime use one capability definition, including BF16 `flashmla_auto` prefill and the hardware-dependent remapping of `flashmla_sparse`. Errors list supported prefill and decode backends separately.

Preserve BF16 Q8 prefill added by #41790. FP8 auto prefill, auto decode, Q8 decode and packed-FP8 pooled-tail combinations remain rejected; non-pooled models, ROCm and existing early-return paths keep their behavior.

Native FlashInfer support in #38430 is still pending. When it lands, its implementation should add `flashinfer_sparse_mla` to the shared capability tuple. The guard edits overlap, so the PR that lands second must preserve the shared guard. This branch continues to reject that runtime path until it is supported.

## Accuracy Tests

Model-override, Q8-routing and stream-scheduling CPU suites pass on the updated branch, along with scoped formatting. The BF16 auto-prefill regression fails before the fix and passes afterward on simulated Hopper and Blackwell. Unsupported Hopper FP8 still fails early.

Combined CPU checks with #38430's native patch passed after resolving the guard through the shared tuple; these also predate the latest base update. No native FlashInfer GPU execution or new Hopper model-server run is claimed.

Run unit suites with `python -m pytest` and formatting with `pre-commit run --files <changed-files>`.

## Speed Tests and Profiling

Not applicable. This changes startup validation and uses the existing runtime capability rules.

## Checklist

- [x] Format your code according to the [Format code with pre-commit](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#format-code-with-pre-commit).
- [x] Add unit tests according to the [Run and add unit tests](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#run-and-add-unit-tests).
- [ ] Update documentation according to [Write documentations](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#write-documentations).
- [ ] Provide accuracy and speed benchmark results according to [Test the accuracy](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#test-the-accuracy) and [Benchmark the speed](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#benchmark-the-speed).
- [x] Follow the SGLang code style [guidance](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#code-style-guidance).

## Review and Merge Process

1. Ping Merge Oncalls to start the process. See the [PR Merge Process](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/MAINTAINER.md#pull-request-merge-process).
2. Get approvals from [CODEOWNERS](https://github.com/sgl-project/sglang/blob/main/.github/CODEOWNERS) and other reviewers.
3. Trigger CI tests with [comments](https://docs.sglang.io/developer_guide/contribution_guide.html#how-to-trigger-ci-tests) or contact authorized users to do so.
   - Common commands include `/tag-and-rerun-ci`, `/tag-run-ci-label`, `/rerun-failed-ci`
4. After green CI and required approvals, ask Merge Oncalls or people with Write permission to merge the PR.

@@ -583,6 +583,63 @@ def _check_dsa_backend_constraints(
         raise ValueError("CUDA TileLang FP8 KV requires SM89 or newer.")
 
 
+def _check_dsa_kpool_backend_support(
+    hf_config: Any,
+    kv_cache_dtype: str,
+    prefill_backend: Optional[str],
+    decode_backend: Optional[str],
+    *,
+    device_sm_major: int,
+) -> None:
+    """Reject DSA backends that cannot serve an index_kpool > 1 model.
+
+    Without this check the server loads the weights and then fails in CUDA
+    graph capture with NotImplementedError from _check_kpool_tail_backend.
+    """
+    from sglang.srt.configs.model_config import get_dsa_index_kpool
+    from sglang.srt.layers.attention.dsa.kpool_backend import (
+        kpool_tail_backends,
+        resolve_kpool_tail_backend,
+        supported_kpool_tail_backends,
+    )
+
+    index_kpool = get_dsa_index_kpool(hf_config)
+    if index_kpool <= 1:
+        return
+    supported = {}
+    unsupported = []
+    bf16_kv = kv_cache_dtype == "bfloat16"
+    for phase, backend in (("prefill", prefill_backend), ("decode", decode_backend)):
+        backends = kpool_tail_backends(phase, bf16_kv=bf16_kv)
+        supported[phase] = ", ".join(
+            supported_kpool_tail_backends(
+                phase, bf16_kv=bf16_kv, device_sm_major=device_sm_major
+            )
+        )
+        if (
+            backend
+            and resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+                backend,
+                device_sm_major,
+                phase=phase,
+                bf16_kv=bf16_kv,
+            )
+            not in backends
+        ):
+            unsupported.append(f"{phase}={backend}")
+    if not unsupported:
+        return
+    raise ValueError(
+        f"{hf_config.architectures[0]} sets index_kpool={index_kpool}, and the "
+        f"{', '.join(unsupported)} DSA backend does not support index_kpool > 1 "
+        f"(kv_cache_dtype={kv_cache_dtype}, prefill={prefill_backend}, "
+        f"decode={decode_backend}). "
+        f"Supported prefill backends: {supported['prefill']}. "
+        f"Supported decode backends: {supported['decode']}. "
+        "Choose a backend supported by the selected KV dtype and GPU."
+    )
+
+
 def _check_tilelang_dsa_fp8_kv(
     kv_cache_dtype: str,
     prefill_backend: Optional[str],
@@ -734,6 +791,10 @@ def _dsa_split_backend_resolution(view: Any) -> dict:
         hip=get_platform().is_hip,
         dcp_size=getattr(view, "dcp_size", 1) or 1,
     )
+    if not get_platform().is_hip:
+        _check_dsa_kpool_backend_support(
+            hf_config, kv_cache_dtype, prefill, decode, device_sm_major=major
+        )
     logger.warning(

         f"prefill={prefill}, decode={decode}."

@@ -39,43 +43,31 @@ def _check_kpool_tail_backend(

         phase: str,
     ) -> None:
-        # q8 prefill consumes the tail columns as ragged ids, like the history
-        # picks. Only over a bfloat16 pool: gathering packed fp8 rows through

-            and phase == "prefill"

             return

         raise NotImplementedError(
             "index_kpool > 1 appends tail tokens to topk_indices and is "
-            f"currently only supported by the FA3/TileLang/TRTLLM DSA {phase} "
-            "backend."
+            f"unsupported by {dsa_impl} during {phase}. Supported backends: "
+            f"{', '.join(supported)}."
         )
 
     def _resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
         self,
         topk_indices: Optional[torch.Tensor],
         dsa_impl: _DSA_IMPL_T,
+        phase: str,
     ) -> _DSA_IMPL_T:
-        if (

-            or self.dsa_index_kpool <= 1
-            or dsa_impl != "flashmla_sparse"
-        ):
+        if topk_indices is None or self.dsa_index_kpool <= 1:
             return dsa_impl
-        if self.device_sm_major >= 10:
-            return "trtllm"
-        if self.device_sm_major == 9:
-            return "fa3"
-        return dsa_impl
+        return resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+            dsa_impl,

+        )
 
     def _kpool_index_page_size(self) -> int:
         return self.token_to_kv_pool.index_page_size

@@ -0,0 +1,48 @@
+"""Backend capabilities for pooled DSA tail tokens."""
+
+KPOOL_TAIL_BACKENDS = ("fa3", "tilelang", "trtllm")
+
+
+def kpool_tail_backends(phase: str, *, bf16_kv: bool) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    if phase == "prefill" and bf16_kv:
+        return (*KPOOL_TAIL_BACKENDS, "flashmla_sparse_q8")
+    return KPOOL_TAIL_BACKENDS
+
+
+def resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+    backend: str,
+    device_sm_major: int,
+    *,
+    phase: str,
+    bf16_kv: bool,
+) -> str:
+    if backend == "flashmla_auto" and phase == "prefill" and bf16_kv:
+        backend = "flashmla_sparse"
+    if backend == "flashmla_sparse":
+        if device_sm_major >= 10:
+            return "trtllm"
+        if device_sm_major == 9:
+            return "fa3"
+    return backend
+
+
+def supported_kpool_tail_backends(
+    phase: str, *, bf16_kv: bool, device_sm_major: int
+) -> tuple[str, ...]:
+    """Return canonical tail backends and aliases that resolve to them."""
+    backends = kpool_tail_backends(phase, bf16_kv=bf16_kv)
+    aliases = ("flashmla_sparse", "flashmla_auto")
+    return (
+        *backends,
+        *(
+            alias
+            for alias in aliases
+            if resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+                alias,
+                device_sm_major,
+                phase=phase,
+                bf16_kv=bf16_kv,
+            )
+            in backends
+        ),
+    )

@@ -2173,7 +2173,7 @@ def forward_extend(
             )
             else "prefill"
         )
-        dsa_impl = self._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(topk_indices, dsa_impl)
+        dsa_impl = self._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(topk_indices, dsa_impl, phase)
         self._check_kpool_tail_backend(topk_indices, dsa_impl, phase)
 
         if dsa_impl == "trtllm" and not self.use_mha:
@@ -2525,7 +2525,9 @@ def forward_decode(
         metadata = self.forward_metadata
         assert causal, "DSA is causal only"
 
-        dsa_impl = self._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(topk_indices, self.dsa_decode_impl)
+        dsa_impl = self._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+            topk_indices, self.dsa_decode_impl, "decode"
+        )
         self._check_kpool_tail_backend(topk_indices, dsa_impl, "decode")
 
         if attn_sink is not None and dsa_impl != "flashmla_sparse":

@@ -195,11 +195,16 @@ def test_kpool_tail_guard_admits_q8_for_prefill_only():
     indices = torch.full((2, 2051), -1, dtype=torch.int32)
     mixin = DeepseekSparseAttnBackendKPoolMixin
     assert (
-        mixin._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(backend, indices, "flashmla_sparse_q8")
+        mixin._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+            backend, indices, "flashmla_sparse_q8", "prefill"
+        )
         == "flashmla_sparse_q8"
     )
     assert (
-        mixin._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(backend, indices, "flashmla_sparse") == "fa3"
+        mixin._resolve_kpool_tail_backend(
+            backend, indices, "flashmla_sparse", "prefill"
+        )
+        == "fa3"
     )
     mixin._check_kpool_tail_backend(backend, indices, "flashmla_sparse_q8", "prefill")
     with pytest.raises(NotImplementedError):

@@ -2438,8 +2438,14 @@ def test_dsa_split_backend_resolution_pass(self):
             _dsa_split_backend_resolution,
         )
 
-        def _view(arch="DeepseekV32ForCausalLM", learnable_sink=False, **kw):
-            hf = SimpleNamespace(architectures=[arch], learnable_sink=learnable_sink)
+        def _view(
+            arch="DeepseekV32ForCausalLM", learnable_sink=False, index_kpool=1, **kw
+        ):
+            hf = SimpleNamespace(
+                architectures=[arch],
+                learnable_sink=learnable_sink,
+                index_kpool=index_kpool,
+            )
             defaults = dict(
                 kv_cache_dtype="fp8_e4m3",
                 dsa_prefill_backend=None,
@@ -2509,6 +2515,87 @@ def _view(arch="DeepseekV32ForCausalLM", learnable_sink=False, **kw):
                             _dsa_split_backend_resolution(
                                 _view(arch=arch, learnable_sink=True, **{field: value})
                             )
+            # index_kpool > 1: Hopper FP8 defaults (flashmla_kv) cannot take the
+            # pooled tail tokens, so reject at resolution time instead of failing
+            # in CUDA graph capture after the weights load.
+            kpool_arch = "Glm5NextForConditionalGeneration"
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "index_kpool=4.*flashmla_kv"):
+                _dsa_split_backend_resolution(_view(arch=kpool_arch, index_kpool=4))
+            # explicit unsupported decode backend is rejected too
+            with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, "flashmla_kv"):
+                _dsa_split_backend_resolution(
+                    _view(
+                        arch=kpool_arch,
+                        index_kpool=4,
+                        kv_cache_dtype="bfloat16",
+                        dsa_decode_backend="flashmla_kv",
+                    )
+                )
+            # Hopper bf16 defaults stay valid: flashmla_sparse is remapped to
+            # fa3 for the kpool tail at run time.
+            self.assertEqual(
+                _dsa_split_backend_resolution(
+                    _view(arch=kpool_arch, index_kpool=4, kv_cache_dtype="bfloat16")
+                ),
+                {
+                    "dsa_prefill_backend": "flashmla_sparse",
+                    "dsa_decode_backend": "fa3",
+                },
+            )
+            # BF16 auto prefill resolves to pooled backends on Hopper and Blackwell.
+            for sm_major, expected_decode in ((9, "fa3"), (10, "trtllm")):
+                with self.subTest(sm_major=sm_major, backend="flashmla_auto"):
+                    with patch(
+                        "torch.cuda.get_device_capability",
+                        return_value=(sm_major, 0),
+                    ):
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            _dsa_split_backend_resolution(
+                                _view(
+                                    arch=kpool_arch,
+                                    index_kpool=4,
+                                    kv_cache_dtype="bfloat16",
+                                    dsa_prefill_backend="flashmla_auto",
+                                )
+                            ),
+                            {"dsa_decode_backend": expected_decode},
+                        )
+
+            # FP8 auto prefill and auto decode still lack pooled-tail support.
+            for field, dtype in (
+                ("dsa_prefill_backend", "fp8_e4m3"),
+                ("dsa_decode_backend", "bfloat16"),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(field=field, dtype=dtype, backend="flashmla_auto"):
+                    with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, field.split("_")[1]):
+                        _dsa_split_backend_resolution(
+                            _view(
+                                arch=kpool_arch,
+                                index_kpool=4,
+                                kv_cache_dtype=dtype,
+                                **{field: "flashmla_auto"},
+                            )
+                        )
+            for field, dtype, error in (
+                ("dsa_prefill_backend", "bfloat16", None),
+                ("dsa_prefill_backend", "fp8_e4m3", "prefill=flashmla_sparse_q8"),
+                ("dsa_decode_backend", "bfloat16", "decode=flashmla_sparse_q8"),
+            ):
+                with self.subTest(field=field, dtype=dtype):
+                    view = _view(
+                        arch=kpool_arch,
+                        index_kpool=4,
+                        kv_cache_dtype=dtype,
+                        **{field: "flashmla_sparse_q8"},
+                    )
+                    if error:
+                        with self.assertRaisesRegex(ValueError, error):
+                            _dsa_split_backend_resolution(view)
+                    else:
+                        self.assertEqual(
+                            _dsa_split_backend_resolution(view),
+                            {"dsa_decode_backend": "fa3"},
+                        )
             # non-family arch declares nothing
             self.assertEqual(
                 _dsa_split_backend_resolution(_view(arch="LlamaForCausalLM")), {}
